title: What If Your AI Agent Never Forgot? 🤯🧠
description:
I explored Letta, a platform for building AI agents with persistent memory and state 🧠🤖

Instead of treating every interaction as a fresh conversation, Letta lets agents store, manage, and retrieve information over time, giving them a persistent state they can use across interactions.

That makes it especially interesting for building AI agents that need to operate over long periods rather than completing just one task.

If you're interested in AI agent memory and stateful agents, Letta is definitely worth checking out.
